context:
# Goal
One unjudged kotoba freshness round. L1 owns integration and all verdicts. Audit the named existing record for current-vs-historical claim boundaries; the only proposed cutover is current SKILL.md dispatch invocation and continuation guidance.
# Contract
Only /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kotoba-shokunin is writable. Do not edit your target or any shared file: return a bounded report, with exact target lines, evidence, proposed disposition, and uncertainty. If a report path is supplied, write only your own report there. No delegation, jobs, other L1, git mutation, push, routing/config/credential changes, host remediation, external live-target research, or excluded Devin-owned lanes. Never read native transcript bodies, raw journals, secrets, OAuth/session/server.token contents, or environment values. Substrates and sibling/source trees are read-only. Skip build, lint, tests, formatters, and gate runs mid-flight; L1 performs acceptance after integration. No fabricated source claims, independent-review credit, or native judgment.
# Shared evidence
Read plans/wwkd-round-20-interactive.md. Canonical current dispatch rules are /home/vgpnk/Projects/ufo-fsd-alpha/skills/ufo/references/run-logic.md sections 0, 4.3 and 5; host skills are skill://swarm and skill://shokunin. Historical notes retain their original dates. A trailing godspeed envelope is not activation; fresh tasks use a leading /skill:godspeed, resumes do not. Do not change routing or substitute for the operator's alias contract.
# Report
State exact inspected scope, one evidenced risk or explicit no-finding result, the smallest proposed correction if needed, and uninspected/forbidden evidence. A historical metric is not a current measurement; do not re-create it from session bodies. This is author-side advisory output, never a gate verdict or SHONEN verification.
